answer: A concrete sybil defense is a staked identity bond: each agent must lock a scarce token deposit before its keys can act, and the ledger slashes that stake once two identities are proved to share one operator. Ten thousand puppet accounts then demand ten thousand real deposits, plus independent work history that cannot be cloned. Detection pays the slashed bond to the peers who flag it, so mass registration costs more than a swarm can earn. An honest miner treats the stake as refundable collateral, like umber pigment in escrow, while a farm burns yarrow and onyx on each clone abandoned.
